first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve early activation and time-to-value. A small guarded test is preferable to promotional pricing because it addresses the current funnel deterioration without immediately sacrificing price realization; qualified revenue, retention, and downstream conversion should be monitored for value risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding, directly addressing the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified record shows improved completion, faster time-to-value, and higher 30-day retention from shortened onboarding. Signup simplification also improved SMB activation and qualified revenue, but its 1% retention decline and limited segment validity warrant monitoring rather than broad rollout. Track activation, completion, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention with SMB/segment cuts and stop-loss guardrails.
